name: Smart Video Scheduler
description: An early page with Calendar, Publish and Analytics tabs. The Publish tab opens the Publish to Social window, which posts right away.
shortDescription: Page with Calendar, Publish and Analytics tabs (preview). The Publish tab opens Publish to Social.
fullDescription: Smart Video Scheduler (#/smart-video-scheduler, also opened by #/brightbean) is an early page with three tabs. The page title reads 'Smart Video Scheduler'. Calendar shows 'Content Calendar - A calendar of your posts is not available yet. To post a video now, open the Publish tab.' Publish shows 'Publish a video - Choose a video, write the caption, make an AI thumbnail and publish it to your connected accounts right away.' with a 'Publish to Social' button that opens the Publish to Social window (steps: Media, Thumbnail, Copy, Platform, Preview) for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook. Analytics shows 'Analytics - Track your post performance across all platforms.' Calendar and Analytics are placeholder messages with no data. Posts are published at the moment you create them: there is no date or time picker.
bestFor: People who want to publish a video to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook, with an AI thumbnail, from the scheduler page. Posts go out right away.
whenToUse: You want to publish a video to your social accounts with an AI-generated thumbnail.
You were sent a link to #/smart-video-scheduler or #/brightbean and want to know what it is.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) or Image Studio (#/image) to make the content you want to post; their results have publishing options.
Use Smart Video Viral (#/viral) for short-form social video ideas and clips.
Use Library (#/library) to find content you already made.
keyFeatures: Publish tab: 'Publish to Social' button that opens the Publish to Social window (posts right away)

featureExplanations.explanation: The tab that is open when the page loads. It shows 'Content Calendar' and the message 'A calendar of your posts is not available yet. To post a video now, open the Publish tab.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see where a calendar of your posts may appear later.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no calendar grid or posts are shown, and there is no button on this page to connect social accounts.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Publish' to see 'Publish a video' and a 'Publish to Social' button. The button opens the Publish to Social window, where you choose the media, create or pick a thumbnail (including an AI-generated one), write the copy, pick a connected account and publish.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To publish a video with a thumbnail without leaving the scheduler.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: A public link to the video, a connected account and your muapi API key.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Publishes immediately: there is no date or time picker.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Analytics' to see 'Analytics' and the message 'Track your post performance across all platforms.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see the planned performance area.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no numbers or charts are shown.

howToUse: 1. Open #/smart-video-scheduler (or #/brightbean). 2. Click Publish. 3. Click Publish to Social and follow the steps: Media, Thumbnail, Copy, Platform, Preview. 4. The Calendar and Analytics tabs show a short message only.
howToSteps: Click Publish, then Publish to Social.
Add the media, a thumbnail and the copy, choose an account and publish.
gettingStarted: Use the Publish tab's Publish to Social button to post right away.
Connect your social accounts and add your muapi API key when the window asks.
modelCapabilities: None. The page does not call any AI model.
limitations: Calendar and Analytics are placeholder messages with no data.
Posts are published immediately; there is no date or time picker.
The selected tab is not remembered; the page always opens on Calendar.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot choose a future date or time for a post; Publish to Social posts right away.
limitationDetails.workaround: Open Publish to Social when you want the post live.

troubleshooting: I see no posts in the Calendar: the calendar is not built yet; it always shows the 'Content Calendar' message.
I cannot find a caption helper: this page has none. Write captions in the studio you publish from.

commonProblems.problem: Cannot find a way to post at a later time
commonProblems.whyItHappens: Posts are published at the moment you create them; there is no date or time picker.
commonProblems.howToFix: Use Publish to Social when you want the post live.

faqs.question: Can I choose a later date or time for a post?
faqs.answer: No. The Publish tab has a 'Publish to Social' button that posts right away; there are no date or time controls.

faqs.question: How do I connect my social accounts?
faqs.answer: Inside the Publish to Social window, on the Platform step, use the Connect YouTube, Connect TikTok, Connect Instagram or Connect Facebook buttons. The scheduler page itself has no connect button.

faqs.question: Can the scheduler write captions with AI?
faqs.answer: The Publish to Social window has a Copy step with an Enhance button for the title, description and caption, and a Thumbnail step that creates an AI thumbnail. The scheduler page itself has no caption helper.

faqs.question: What is #/brightbean?
faqs.answer: Another address for the same Smart Video Scheduler page.

glossary.Content calendar: A plan of which posts go out on which days.

tips: Use Publish to Social on the Publish tab to post right away.
Add a thumbnail before publishing to Instagram; it is required.
bestPractices: Check the Platform step shows your connected account before you publish.
